home_root._note: S40 Slice-2 Finding #1 (per-image HOME). dominant_hue (deg, 0..360) -> chromatic pitch class -> seated into the [57,68] register band by the planner. ABSENT block => home_root_midi = 60 (C4) byte-for-byte (serde default None). The [lo,hi] band is the Theory-owned register-safety guard (design-s38-theory.md 2.2): hi MUST NOT exceed 68 without re-deriving the 81<<96 / 103<<108 headroom margins, because melody floor 67 + bright-lift + a degree-+7 motif already sits near the top-end clamp; the band spans exactly 12 semitones [57=A3 .. 68=G#4] so every pitch class has exactly one in-band representative (seating is total). hue->pc rationale: UNIFORM 30-deg-per-pc synesthetic color-wheel -> chromatic-wheel identity (red=hue 0 -> C/pc 0, ascending clockwise around both 12-fold circles). Chosen over a non-uniform perceptual spacing because the uniform 1:1 spreads natural-image hues most EVENLY across all 12 homes -- directly serving cross-image differentiation (the 'by ~4th image, motifs sound familiar' observation): a 30-deg hue rotation always lands a new chromatic home, and no large hue range collapses onto one pc. Coherent with global.hue_to_mode (same hue-domain 'lo-hi' convention over 0..360): warm reds/oranges (Phrygian/Lydian) take the low chromatic homes C..D#, greens (Ionian) the central E..F, cyans/blues (Dorian/Aeolian) F#..G#, violets/magentas (Mixolydian) A..A#, wrapping back toward B at the red boundary -- color heat tracks rising chromatic center without contradicting the mode the same hue picks.

theme_behaviour._note: S62 fix-direction-1 (UN-GATE THE PITCHED MOTIF): default flipped 'absent' -> 'fragment' so EVERY real image carries a per-image melodic subject. Previously default was 'absent' with a single rule complexity>=0.4 -> 'fragment', which left 4 of 6 bundled photos (complexity 0.005-0.229) theme-LESS: they fell back to the realizer's generic melodization and sounded like 'the same tune everywhere' (docs/diagnostic-s62-motivic-derivation.md). This is a ROUTING change only — the subject is still one of the authored 8 archetype contours (chord_engine::MotifArchetype); no new melodic vocabulary. A real image now always has a subject (the diagnostic found no image that is legitimately better off theme-less); rules is empty because the default applies to all. The rhythm gait remains complexity-gated (pick_rhythm_cell, unchanged) and the per-piece motto (S53) is independent of this seam.

motif_rhythm._note: DATA MIRROR (S41 DP-6 discipline retained): a tunable copy of the per-archetype rhythm-cell VOCABULARIES authored inline in chord_engine.rs::MotifArchetype::rhythm_cells(). The inline Rust cells are AUTHORITATIVE — resolve_motif_celled does NOT read this block (no loader wiring this slice; QG confirms inert). Each cell is a list of dur_steps weights (steps, >= 1) cycled across the sampled contour until Σ dur_steps fills length_steps; Σ is then capped at length_steps so the motif never over-runs its section. cell 0 of every archetype MUST equal the S39 single profile (freeze anchor) — the first row of every list below is the pre-S41 profile, byte-for-byte. Cell ordering is BROAD(1) -> BUSY(2) -> PROFILED/SYNCOPATED(3) (see the rhythm_cells doc). Keep in sync with the inline cells if either is edited.

_index_cuts._note: Affect/Aesthetics (DP-A) fill the exact band edges; this is a MIRROR only — composition::pick_rhythm_cell is authoritative this slice and the inert cells above are not loader-wired.

affect._s91_tempo_note: S91-S3. TEMPO IS AN ENERGY PARAMETER AND IT WAS BEING DRIVEN BY AN EXPOSURE METER. It used to be interp(global.brightness_to_tempo_bpm, avg_brightness) and NOTHING else, then CLAMPED into character_tempo. Because that curve floors at 72 BPM and the old lament window ceiling was 66, every lament pinned to exactly 66.0 and a sub-66 BPM piece was impossible for ANY image that could ever exist. The four lament images differ in brightness by 3.6 points but in MOTION by an order of magnitude, so the information to separate them was already in the feature vector and the tempo surface was discarding it. NOW: bpm = (energy_tempo line evaluated at tempo_energy) * character_tempo_factor, then bounded by character_tempo.
affect._s91_energy_note: MOTION only. avg_brightness and avg_saturation are DELIBERATELY ABSENT: exposure is not energy (a dark image is not necessarily a slow one), and vividness is not motion (a saturated but perfectly still image should be SLOW). This is a SEPARATE blend from arousal_weights on purpose -- arousal is a GATING coordinate that sorts the character ladder, and re-weighting it would move character/home_mode. This blend feeds tempo and nothing else.
affect._s91_factor_note: The character SHIFTS the tempo MULTIPLICATIVELY, it does not clamp it. Perceived tempo difference is a RATIO (the ~8% JND is scale-free), so a per-character multiplier leaves every within-character ratio EXACTLY invariant: the character can say 'a lament is slower than a march' as loudly as it likes and remain arithmetically incapable of collapsing two laments onto each other. A window-clamp destroys ratios; a blend toward a window centre is a contraction map and compresses them. A multiplier is the transformation that shifts without saturating.
affect._s91_rail_note: character_tempo is DEMOTED from shaper to SAFETY RAIL: a wide, musically absolute per-character bound (the tempo range beyond which the character name stops being true), there to bound a pathological image, NOT to position an ordinary one. If a rail is ever seen to bind on a real image it is too tight and should be widened -- a tempo produced by a rail is a tempo not produced by the image, which is the defect this surface exists to remove. Verified: 0 of the 9 corpus images sit on a rail. lament was widened from 44..66 (its ceiling sat BELOW the old curve's 72 floor -- the bug) and march from 96..132 (which would have re-pinned s3 at 132). scherzo 120..168 and ballad 56..96 are RETAINED at their legacy values because those genuinely are the standard tempo ranges for those characters.

rules._s92_note: S92 P2 2.6 HARMONIC-JOURNEY RE-ANCHOR (the WRONG-KNOB fix; C5(b)). The catch-all key excursion is gated on COMPLEXITY (harmonic density), not fg_bg_contrast (subject pop-out). A key excursion is a HARMONIC argument -- leaving home and earning the way back -- justified by harmonic MATERIAL, not by subject separation. fg_bg pointed the wrong way: it granted modulation to s1 (fg_bg 0.363) and would to s6 (0.187), the images the AD wants STILL/home-anchored, while denying it to the harmonically dense ones. complexity >= 0.60 grants the excursion to {s3 (0.997), s5 (0.884)} -- the two images with the density to sustain a modulation-and-return -- and holds home_only for every complexity<0.60 image, INCLUDING s1 (0.473) and s6 (0.042), which MUST NOT modulate (C5(b)). The other five excursion rules KEEP their fg_bg co-predicate on purpose: it is the guard that keeps s7/s8a home (their aaba rule would otherwise fire on aspect_ratio alone -- a non-harmonic reason). Only the catch-all's coordinate is swapped (design §2.6: replace, do NOT merely remove). Margin: s3/s5 sit >> 0.02 above 0.60; s1 (0.473) sits 0.127 below (C2). The `edge_activity < 0.60` and `aspect_ratio < 1.60` guards are STRUCTURAL, not affect re-anchors: they keep this catch-all firing ONLY for images that take the DEFAULT `rounded_binary` FORM, preserving the form<->key_scheme role isomorphism the planner's role-alignment witness (composition.rs ~2680 `debug_assert`) enforces. Without them a high-complexity image that takes the `theme_and_variations` form (edge>=0.6, e.g. the example.jpg fixture) or the `aaba` form (aspect>=1.6) would be handed this 3-section [home,region,home] scheme, whose section-2 `home` rule would land on a `Development`/`Statement` role -> a witnessed mismatch. Both guards are TRUE for s3 (edge 0.487, rb form) and s5 (edge 0, rb form), so they do not change the modulating set {s3,s5} or C5(b); they reproduce the pre-fix `home_only` outcome for the t&v/aaba-form images exactly as before.

texture_catalogue._s63_note: S63 INTEGRATION move-(a): default figuration so the counter images (Img1/2/3) animate the Pad instead of holding a static block. arp_waltz (onsets 0/.33/.66) is chosen over block_comp_24 (.25/.75) because the counter images are F5a-fragile (AudioHaxImg1 anti-fusion baseline 0.518, razor-thin above the 0.50 floor): the .33/.66 motto-complement grid stays DISTINCT from the moving CounterMelody's grid, where the .25/.75 grid fused it below the floor. Chosen by measurement against variety_scorecard_s45's S49 F5a gate.

texture_catalogue._s94_note: S94 B1 s4 ARM — the SUBORDINATE SUSTAINED GROUND restored under the dialogue. Identical to `pad_bed_counter` in every field EXCEPT that it carries NO `figuration`: that one omission is the whole fix. In the frozen realizer a Pad with `pad_voices > 0` and NO figuration is the HELD BLOCK BED (each of its 3 chord tones sounds for PAD_OVERLAP_FRAC = 1.10 of the step, so consecutive steps TIE and the bed reads as one continuous floor — the same construction that measures held on s5 0.480 / s7 0.413). With a figuration the Pad is instead handed to `realize_figuration`, whose per-onset hold is a fraction of the GAP TO THE NEXT ONSET, so NO onset can span the step: `arp_waltz` shatters the bed into plucks, and the S63 motto-complement thinning reduces s4's bed to a SINGLE 423 ms stab inside a 1243 ms step (measured). That is §8's 'the ground is shattered' and §3's 'two chiefs, no servant' in code. Restoring the bed is the s4 brief's OWN mandate ('a deep sustained bass anchor throughout = the shared darkness as floor') and §12's ruling that s4 wants a SERVANT, not another chief. DIRECTION: this adds NO voice — `layers` and `pad_voices` are byte-identical to `pad_bed_counter`, so s4 keeps EXACTLY TWO independent melodic voices (Melody + CounterMelody, the lean-and-answer dialogue) and the restored element is a bed, never a third protagonist. A SEPARATE catalogue row (rather than editing `pad_bed_counter` in place) is REQUIRED by corpus safety: s3 and s8b also realize `pad_bed_counter`, and their arp_waltz must not move. Routed by the s4-only `valence < 0.25` rule in the `texture` table below.

texture_catalogue._s92_note: S92 P2 T2 MONODY ENTRY (the sameness-hunt 'dead cuts' build). A genuinely SINGLE-LINE texture: a Melody over a sustained tonic pedal Bass, with NO Pad (pad_voices 0), NO HarmonicFill, NO CounterMelody. Every other real texture profile is a 4-layer/3-pad-voice stack, so withholding the counter-melody only made an image THINNER, never MONODIC (design §5.3). This entry makes the pre-registered s4-vs-s6 split AUDIBLE: s4 (the two Dassy brothers) realizes the plural pad_bed_counter dialogue; s6 (the single veiled Cameron woman) realizes THIS unbroken line, alone. Layer order [Melody,Bass] is load-bearing: assign_role clamps instruments past the layer list onto the LAST named layer, so instruments 2..N reinforce the Bass PEDAL (a drone) rather than doubling into a second independent melodic voice — the sparsest melodic texture the frozen realizer can express. NO explicit `bass_pattern`: it is a non-identity profile (layers non-empty), so the S63 motto->bass path grounds the Bass on the per-piece motto cell; s6's cell is 1 (broad/calm) -> a tonic PEDAL, exactly the sustained pedal wanted. Omitting the explicit handle keeps the s34 freeze-guard (`only pad_walking/pad_pedal carry a bass_pattern`) GREEN. Justified under the catalogue-gaming exemption (B8/B9): its warrant is the audible split (C9/the ear), NOT a distinct-texture count (a T2-improved-BAR-D claim is a C6 fail — s6 already differs from s4 in gait once s4 gets the counter; T2 changes the QUALITY of s6's line). Routed by the `colorfulness lt 0.10` monody rule in the `texture` table below.

rules._s92_note: S92 P2 T2 MONODY ROUTING — s6 -> the true single-line texture. Chromatic UNITY (near-monochrome soft-focus, colorfulness < 0.10) reads as CONTRAPUNTAL unity: one unbroken line, alone. The valence window [0.25,0.48) is a SEATED-affect guard so the rule fires only on a real planned image (neutral()/un-seated probes carry valence -1 and are EXCLUDED -> the Ge-only sentinel discipline holds: neutral stays pad_bed) and NOT on the bright/high-valence corners (s5 0.570, s7 0.714, s8a 0.519). The edge_activity < 0.10 term is a STILLNESS guard: s6 is a motionless portrait (edge 0.0); it separates s6 from the still-but-textured legacy fixture AudioHaxImg1 (colorfulness 0.011, valence 0.338 -- same window as s6 -- but edge 0.301), which must keep its foreground-counter routing. On the real corpus this isolates ONLY s6 (colorfulness 0.026, edge 0.0, valence 0.341): s7 (colorfulness 0.016) is excluded by its edge 0.210 AND its valence 0.714 >= 0.48. Placed FIRST so s6's monody wins its cascade. Margins > 0.02 from every image on all four cuts (C2).

rules._s94_note: S94 B1 s4 ARM ROUTING — the SUBORDINATE-GROUND texture, cut so narrowly it reaches s4 and NOTHING else. s4 is the corpus's DARK pole: it is the only image whose seated valence falls below 0.25 (s4 0.1999; the next-lowest is s2 at 0.2943, and the next-lowest that is also colorful is s3 at 0.4332), which is the affect reading of the two brothers' shared darkness — exactly the 'shared darkness as floor' the s4 brief names. The `colorfulness >= 0.30` AND `arousal >= 0.13` terms are INHERITED VERBATIM from the 2.2 voice-number rule immediately below (the arousal term is 2.2's synthetic-fixture guard: the unit-test `wave` fixture is colorful (0.5) and sits in this valence window (0.2) but carries arousal 0.1, so it is excluded by construction and its golden is unmoved — s4 clears it at 0.1666, margin 0.037), so this rule is a strict REFINEMENT of that rule's catch set {s3,s4,s8b}: it can only re-point an image that would already have taken `pad_bed_counter`, never pull in a new one. The `valence >= 0.10` term is the SEATED-affect floor (the same guard 2.2 uses): the synthetic/un-seated unit fixtures carry valence 0 or -1 and are EXCLUDED by construction, so no golden moves. CORPUS SAFETY (seal C6): on the nine-image corpus the `valence < 0.25` cut catches ONLY s4 — s3 (0.4332) and s8b (0.6048) stay on `pad_bed_counter` with their arp_waltz UNTOUCHED, and every other piece fails the colorfulness term as well. On the legacy fixtures the minimum seated valence is AudioHaxImg1 at 0.3379, so NONE of the six is reached (margin 0.088 above the cut). Margins: s4 sits 0.050 below the 0.25 cut and 0.100 above the 0.10 floor; the nearest image on the far side is s2 at 0.0443 above the cut — every margin > 0.02 (the C2 discipline). Placed AFTER the s6 monody rule (s6's colorfulness 0.0255 fails the 0.30 term anyway) and BEFORE 2.2 so the refinement wins its cascade. This rule is DELIBERATELY not generalized: the seal forbids a corpus-wide 'bind every piece' rule, and a wider cut that caught a third image would be a structural FAIL even if that image sounded fine.

rules._s92_note: S92 P2 2.2 VOICE-NUMBER RE-ANCHOR (the WRONG-KNOB fix; C5(a)). The counter-melody / contrapuntal PLURALITY is gated on COLORFULNESS, not fg_bg_contrast. fg_bg_contrast measures subject-vs-ground pop-out, NOT subject COUNT, and points the WRONG way for the acceptance pair: s6 (0.187) exceeds s4 (0.051) on fg_bg, so the old fg_bg gate would hand the dialogue to the solitary woman. Chromatic PLURALITY (a varied palette) tracks contrapuntal plurality: s4 (the two brothers, colorfulness 0.397) gets the counter; s6 (the single woman, colorfulness 0.026) does NOT (it takes the monody rule above). Cut 0.30 sits in the wide gap between s8a (0.247) and s8b (0.368). The arousal>=0.13 / valence>=0.10 terms are LOW seated-affect floors that every real colorful image clears; they exist only to keep the synthetic unit-test fixtures (waltz/wave/high: colorful but inert or un-seated) on their original rules below -- they do NOT re-introduce fg_bg and do NOT change any corpus routing. Catches {s3,s4,s8b}. Placed AHEAD of the driving rule so a colorful structured image takes the moving contrapuntal line rather than a bare figuration (the S45 'structured subject -> moving counter' call, preserved). This SUPERSEDES the old fg_bg-gated pad_bed_counter rule (kept below as a lower-priority fallback for back-compat + its unit test).

S92 P2 2.3 FIGURATION/GAIT LIVELINESS RE-ANCHOR onto EDGE_ACTIVITY (motion), off arousal (which is 45% saturation-led and fires 'busy' on vivid-but-still images). A driving/busy figuration for genuinely active images: edge_activity >= 0.35 -> pad_broken_up. On the corpus this reaches {s1 (edge 0.550, the Tiffany 'ring that iterates') and s8a (edge 0.399, the synthwave 'propulsive gridded' drive)} -- s3 (edge 0.487) is diverted to the counter above first (structured+colorful). The still images (s2,s4,s5,s6,s7: edge < 0.21) keep the broad/sustained default. The valence < 0.60 term keeps the driving figuration on DARK-energetic images (s1 dark val 0.307, s8a neon val 0.519) and off BRIGHT-but-detailed ones: it excludes the legacy Lena fixture (edge 0.471 but valence 0.650, a smooth bright portrait whose detail is not motion), preserving its arp_waltz + the S63 h3 onset-interlock property. Both corpus driving targets sit below 0.60 (C2 margin: nearest is s8a at 0.081). The subject_energy < 0.45 term yields to the clear-subject `pad_figured` rule below (a strong foreground subject warrants the figured accompaniment, not a generic drive); subject_energy is a dead knob for the corpus (all 9 << 0.056), so s1/s8a keep driving. Coupled to 2.2 as ONE first-match cascade (design §4).

rules._comment: S45/Slice-1 RE-TUNE: gate the CounterMelody routing on fg_bg_contrast, NOT foreground_energy. A feature-distribution probe over all 6 test images showed foreground_energy is a near-dead axis (real images emit 0.003-0.039, tightly clustered 4-10x BELOW the old 0.15 floor) so the counter routing fired on ZERO real images. fg_bg_contrast is the well-separated discriminating knob (0.052-0.341 across the set). The fe>=0.015 term is therefore only a TOKEN FLOOR (every real image clears it); fg_bg_contrast>=0.15 is the REAL gate. This routes the three structured images (AudioHaxImg1 ct=0.341, AudioHaxImg2 ct=0.284, AudioHaxImg3 ct=0.203) to the moving CounterMelody and keeps the two calmest (Lena ct=0.052, magicstudio ct=0.084) on the static pad_bed fallback. example.jpg (ct=0.136, below this gate but colorful) stays on pad_broken_wave. AudioHaxImg3 (colorfulness 0.423 would otherwise select pad_broken_wave) is INTENTIONALLY routed to the counter here: it sits AHEAD of pad_broken_wave in the table, so a structured colorful image gets the moving contrapuntal line rather than the broken-wave figuration — a deliberate musical call (structured subject -> moving counter), left for the operator to ear-judge. Both thresholds are operator-tunable.

S63 INTEGRATION move-(a): re-tune so the calm real-photo cluster (colorfulness/valence > 0) reaches a FIGURED accompaniment instead of collapsing onto the block pad_bed default (5/6 images were un-figured — diagnostic-s63-vocabulary-breadth.md). arp_waltz gate relaxed valence>=0.65 & color>=0.50 -> valence>=0.60 & color>=0.10: this routes the bright low-contrast FIELD image (Lena val 0.650 col 0.122) to a gentle arpeggiated waltz bed. The synthetic variety_s45 Property-B calm fixtures carry colorfulness=0/valence=0 so this rule NEVER fires for them (they keep pad_bed) — only the real corpus (color/val>0) is re-routed. ROUTING-only over the existing figuration_catalogue; no new figures.

S63 INTEGRATION move-(a): route the mid-arousal / lower-valence, un-colorful-but-COMPLEX real photo (magicstudio: arousal 0.389, valence 0.459, complexity 1.0) to the broken-wave figuration instead of the STATIC block pad_bed default — the last un-figured corpus image (diagnostic-s63 offender #1). Gated on the AFFECT composite (arousal/valence), which the planner SEATS before selection; the un-seated probes (s52_probe_identity.rs) and the neutral variety_s45 fixtures carry arousal=valence=0 so this rule is INVISIBLE to them (their goldens/fallbacks are unmoved) — it fires ONLY on the real seated plan. colorfulness>=0.40 stays the primary broken_wave route (above) so example.jpg's un-seated golden is preserved. Routing-only over the existing figuration_catalogue.

prominence_catalogue._s94_note: S94 B1 s4 ARM (second half) — `melody_lead_gentle` with the Pad at the NEUTRAL 0.50 instead of 0.45. Every other weight is byte-identical, so the voice HIERARCHY is untouched: Melody 0.74 and CounterMelody 0.65 still sit far above the bed, which stays a servant. The single 0.05 move exists because of a hard realizer fact: `pad_onset_cap` returns NO CAP iff the Pad weight is >= PAD_RECESSION_THRESHOLD (0.50), and below it the S47 bed-activity governor caps the bed's onset count to the melody's per-class minimum and — when every survivor is still on the downbeat — DISPLACES the surviving stab to the weak beat. At 0.45 s4's restored block bed was therefore thinned to a SINGLE tone pushed to mid-step on every Sustained-melody step (measured: `n66@622+745` inside a 1243 ms step), i.e. the bed was handed back to the realizer and re-shattered — the very C1(c) failure the s4 arm exists to cure. At 0.50 the bed sounds as built: its inner tones attack together at offset 0 and hold PAD_OVERLAP_FRAC (1.10) of the step, so consecutive steps TIE and the ground is genuinely continuous (measured: `n66@0+1367 n58@0+1367` per non-cadence step). This is the SAME single fix as the texture row, completed — the texture row supplies a bed, this lets it sound like one. It does NOT add a voice, does NOT touch the dialogue, and leaves the cadence ring (the frozen realizer's own early-return) untouched. Bound to s4 alone by the rule below.

rules._s94_note: S94 B1 s4 ARM ROUTING (prominence half) — the SAME s4-only cut the `texture` table uses (colorfulness >= 0.30 AND arousal >= 0.13 AND 0.10 <= valence < 0.25), repeated verbatim so the two halves of the s4 arm are bound to EXACTLY the same one image and cannot drift apart. Placed FIRST so it wins the cascade; s4 would otherwise fall to `melody_lead_gentle` via the SHALLOW/field rule at the bottom (its fg_bg_contrast is 0.051), and `melody_lead_gentle_ground` IS that profile with only the Pad moved to neutral — so this rule REFINES s4's existing tier rather than re-tiering it. CORPUS SAFETY (seal C6): identical margins to the texture rule — on the corpus only s4 (valence 0.1999) is caught; s3 (0.4332) and s8b (0.6048) are the only other images clearing the colorfulness term and both fail the valence cut by a wide margin, and every legacy fixture sits at valence >= 0.3379. The un-seated synthetic fixtures (valence 0 / -1) are excluded by the 0.10 seated-affect floor, so no golden moves.

rules._comment: DEEP/subject: high fg_bg_contrast → a clear separated subject justifies a strong lead + deep bed recession. FIRST so it wins over the gentler tiers. EAR-TUNABLE threshold [0.20,0.30]; the SIGN (higher contrast → deeper tier) is load-bearing.
The existing subject_melody escalation tier — PRESERVED verbatim; a small, separated subject in the mid-contrast band.
SHALLOW/field: low contrast, even energy → the texture legitimately shares focus (no forced lead on an abstract image). EAR-TUNABLE threshold [0.08,0.12].

phrase_scheme._note: S64 PHRASE-PERIOD SPREAD — the single deepest lever against the transcribed cross-piece 'Wizard of Oz' rhythmic skeleton (docs/diagnostic-s64-fixed-rhythm-key.md, docs/design-s64-phrase-period-spread.md). Selects ONE curated phrase/cadence SCHEME per image (uniform-per-piece, mirroring the S53 motto grain) so the CADENCE POSITIONS the ear locks onto vary across pieces. The SCHEMES are real common-practice archetypes authored in chord_engine.rs::PhraseScheme, and all four are CADENCE-DENSITY-BOUNDED (<= the legacy 2 cadences per 8-step section) so none adds homophonic cadence-ring steps that would fuse role pairs below the S49 F5a within-piece anti-fusion floor: period_4 = legacy 4/8 periods, cadences {3,7}; phrase_5 = an asymmetric 5+3 period, cadences {4,7}; group_6 = a broad 6-step phrase + short tail, cadences {5,7}; sentence_8 = one 8-step Schoenberg sentence (2+2+4), a SINGLE cadence {7} (density 1). The AXIS is complexity (primary) + edge_activity (secondary) — the SAME knobs the form gate reads — so the choice tracks the image's structural energy. FREEZE: default 'period_4' + PhraseScheme::from_id maps any absent/typo id to the LEGACY Period4, whose plan_phrases output is byte-identical to pre-S64; the neutral/identity path (complexity 0) takes the default, so engine_equivalence and every identity witness are unmoved. BALANCE LAW: curated authored menu + real feature seed, deterministic, NO RNG. Corpus spread (complexity, edge_activity → scheme): Img1(0.005,0.301)→period_4, Img2(0.015,0.509)→period_4, Lena(0.164,0.471)→phrase_5, AudioHaxImg3(0.229,0.475)→group_6, example(0.905,0.719)→sentence_8, magicstudio(1.000,0.106)→period_4 (rule 2, the high-complexity/low-motion outlier — see the F4 note) — all 4 schemes reached, no collapse. Img1 deliberately stays on period_4 so the razor-thin F5a anti-fusion baseline (0.518) is UNTOUCHED. A symmetric 3-step-group scheme (cadence periodicity 3) was designed and REJECTED: tripling the cadence rate fused a role pair onto the shared ring and regressed the S49 F5a baseline on the 0.743-baseline images (Lena/Img3) — see the design doc. Thresholds are operator-tunable against the observed feature ranges.

rules._comment: BUSY + ENERGETIC (dense surface driving to one goal) → a SENTENCE: continuation-with-fragmentation makes a single 8-step push to one terminal cadence (density 1). example.jpg (complexity 0.905, edge 0.719).

VERY DENSE but STATIC (max complexity, LOW edge_activity — a saturated field with no linear/structural motion) → KEEP the LEGACY period. Rationale: phrasing variety should track an image's sense of MOVEMENT; a motionless field has no internal articulation to hang off-square cadences on, and empirically ANY cadence-repositioning (phrase_5/group_6/sentence_8) drops magicstudio's already-low-seated melody (edge 0.106) below the S48 F4 inverse-register-comp threshold on a degenerate 4-step sample. So the densest-but-most-static image honestly keeps the normative {3,7} period. magicstudio-art.jpg (complexity 1.000, edge 0.106). This rule sits AFTER the busy+energetic sentence rule so example (which HAS motion, edge 0.719) still takes sentence_8; it catches only the high-complexity LOW-motion outlier.
DENSE / mid-high detail → a BROAD 6-step phrase (cadences {5,7}): a long, unhurried arc that pushes the first cadence later. AudioHaxImg3.jpg (complexity 0.229).

LOW-MID detail → an ASYMMETRIC 5+3 PERIOD (cadences {4,7}): an off-square period that walks the interior cadence one step later than the legacy {3,7}. Lena.png (0.164). Floor 0.1 keeps the near-zero-complexity images (Img1 0.005, Img2 0.015) on the legacy period_4 default (also F5a-protective for Img1). Density-neutral (2 cadences), so F5a is unregressed.

ensemble_catalogue.label: Veiled solo cello over the shipped reed pedal
ensemble_catalogue._s95_note: S95 — the UNBUNDLED s6 arm, and the working-tree DEFAULT. It changes exactly ONE program from the shipped dark_reeds [70,60,69,71]: voice 0's bassoon (70) becomes a cello (42). Voices 1-3 — the tripled Bass tonic pedal — are the SHIPPED reeds, byte-unchanged. This isolates the one change the S12 ruling RATIFIED (the s6 brief names a 'muted/soft flute/VIOL'; a cello is viol-family and beats the shipped bassoon on the brief's own text) from the halo, which the same ruling put on affirmative-consent terms. Positional overlap with s7's lush_strings [42,48,41,40] is 1/4 (GM 42 at voice 0, the ratified cello) — the same residual the halo row carries, so the s6/s7 rank measured at this rung isolates the CELLO's contribution to the collision from the halo's. NOTE the honest consequence of unbundling: the cello alone does far less for continuity than the halo did (floor_ratio 0.027 -> 0.0326 vs the halo's 0.1033), so this default does NOT clear the C5 continuity screen. That is the ruling's deliberate trade — it declined to buy the floor with a change that reads as a second voice — and it leaves s6's continuity defect substantially UNFIXED and in the ear's hands.

ensemble_catalogue.label: Veiled solo cello over a warm-pad halo (STAGED, NOT ROUTED)
ensemble_catalogue._s95_note: S95 — GM 48 (String Ensemble) DROPPED per the S12 unbundling ruling; voice 0 (42, Cello) RATIFIED and kept. THE FINDING THIS ROW ENCODES: the S94 build handed s6 two of s7's four programs IN S7'S OWN VOICE SLOTS — veiled_halo was [42,48,89,89] against s7's lush_strings [42,48,41,40], a position-for-position overlap of 2/4 where the shipped dark_reeds [70,60,69,71] had 0/4. That, not a generic wash, was ruled the cause of the s6/s7 collision, and GM 48 was ruled the sole carrier of BOTH adverse findings: it is also the trope-carrier (solo-cello-over-strings is the over-learned soloist-and-section schema, which trips the s6 brief's failure #1 on the brief's operative verb — 'nothing that READS AS a second voice', a perceptual test, not a structural one). Warm Pads (89) were ruled neutral, so voices 1-3 take 89: they still all clamp onto the SAME Bass tonic pedal, so what sounds is ONE pedal pitch reinforced in one long-release timbre — resonance, not a section. HONEST RESIDUAL, measured and NOT papered over: dropping GM 48 takes the positional overlap with s7 from 2/4 to 1/4, NOT to 0/4. The surviving match is GM 42 at voice 0 — the ratified cello itself. It lands on s6's MELODY and on s7's BASS (s7's layers are [Bass,Pad,HarmonicFill,Melody]), so the same program carries a different structural role in each piece, which is the likeliest reason it is the milder of the two matches; but it IS a residual positional collision and the s6/s7 rank is the number that decides whether it matters. BURDEN OF PROOF INVERTED: this row is AUTHORED BUT NOT ROUTED. The default the working tree ships is `veiled_solo` (the cello alone, no halo) — the halo does not ship unless the ear affirmatively asks for it. To arm this row, change the `veiled_solo` pick in the instrumentation rule below to `veiled_halo`; nothing else moves.

instrumentation._note: S74b/B5 DIFFERENTIAL INSTRUMENTATION — per-image GM ensemble keyed off SPREAD raw image features (NOT the compressed affect projection). Generalizes the 6-image ear-approved lookup into a feature->ensemble RULE for arbitrary images (Perceptual/Cross-Modal S74b, arch b5-instrumentation-build-arch.md). Two-stage: hue picks a temperature ZONE (cool->mallets, violet->ethereal), then the crowded WARM zone splits by brightness x edge x texture. Order is load-bearing (first-match-wins): hue zones first, then warm splitters (reeds BEFORE brass), then default. Selects a voice-indexed programs array from ensemble_catalogue; the emission is per-voice-index at t=0 in the main.rs adapter (NOT role-keyed — voice-indexed is freeze-critical: role-keying collapses v1/v2 HarmonicFill and breaks the approved golden). Grounding: brightness->register HIGH, edge->attack HIGH, hue->family MEDIUM (garnish). FREEZE: absent axis / empty catalogue -> every voice falls to legacy_program(i)=(i*7)%128 (byte-identical to pre-B5). Corpus trace: example(hue198.7)->cool_mallets, magic(hue278.3)->ethereal_violet, Img1(bri29)->dark_reeds, Img2(bri81,edge0.51,cfl0.08)->bright_brass, Img3(cfl0.42)->warm_plucked, Lena(tex0.19,sat52)->lush_strings.

rules._s94_note: S94 B1 s6 ARM ROUTING (S95: now picks `veiled_solo`, the unbundled cello-only default — the halo row is staged but NOT routed, per the ruling that inverted the burden of proof onto the halo). Bound to s6 alone. NOTE THE KNOB DISCIPLINE: the `instrumentation` table is selected from the RAW ImageUnderstanding (main.rs calls `select_programs` BEFORE the affect projection is seated), so the seated `valence`/`arousal` guards the texture and prominence rules use are NOT AVAILABLE here — they read as un-seated and would never match. The cut is therefore built from RAW features only: colorfulness < 0.10 AND edge_activity < 0.10 AND avg_saturation >= 30. On the corpus this isolates s6 (colorfulness 0.0255, edge 0.0, saturation 40.8) exactly: s7 is the only other image under the colorfulness cut (0.0161) and is excluded by its edge 0.210; s4 (edge 0.031) and s5 (edge 0.0) are the only other images under the edge cut and both fail colorfulness (0.397 / 0.220) by a wide margin. On the legacy fixtures AudioHaxImg1 (colorfulness 0.0108) and AudioHaxImg2 (0.0800) clear the colorfulness cut but are excluded by their edge (0.3009 / 0.5094). The `avg_saturation >= 30` term is the UN-SEATED-FIXTURE GUARD that replaces the valence floor used elsewhere: a synthetic/zero-valued probe carries saturation 0 and is excluded by construction, and it doubles as a real discriminator (s6 at 40.8 is the most saturated of the low-colorfulness images by 24 points). Margins: colorfulness 0.074 to the cut, edge 0.10, saturation 10.8 — all well past the 0.02 discipline. Placed FIRST: s6 would otherwise resolve to `dark_reeds` through the warm-hue splitter, and this rule is strictly narrower than any hue zone (every cool/violet-zone image fails the colorfulness cut: magicstudio 0.287, example 0.686, s5 0.220, s3 0.582), so it cannot preempt one.

rules._c: COOL-STRUCK: cyan/teal hue -> metallic mallets. example.jpg (hue 198.7).

S92 P2 T3 NEON SYNTH SPLIT: a SATURATED violet -> bright analog synth (leads + polysynth pad). The sat gate lives INSIDE the hue[240,300) violet branch and PRECEDES the ethereal_violet catch so the violet zone SUBDIVIDES by saturation: the SATURATED blue-violet (s8a synthwave-miami, hue 263.4, sat 57.9) reads as NEON; the DESATURATED violets (s3 virgin-enthroned hue 296.7 sat 19.8; s5 monet-mist hue 251.3 sat 13.7) stay ETHEREAL (cool/misty), unchanged at programs [89,52,8,10]. Delivers the pre-registered s3-vs-s8a ensemble split (design test B). SATURATION (not hue-280) is the separator: a hue cut would sweep s5 into bright with s8a (they are 12deg apart on the blue-violet side; s3 is the hue outlier) -- so the split MUST be on sat. Threshold 50 (not the design's seed ~40): the guard requires s3/s5 to stay ethereal AND the C8 must-stay-green fixture u_magic (hue 278.3, sat 43.6) to stay ethereal_violet -- both sit below 50; s8a (57.9) sits above. Warm-hue high-sat images (s6 sat 40.8 hue 39.4; s7 sat 57.4 hue 36.8) never reach this branch: their warm hues resolve to dark_reeds/lush_strings BEFORE the violet zone. Catalogue authoring justified by the audible split (the axis the AD 'most wants opened'), certified by the ear (C9), NOT by an ensemble count (C6).
WARM . dark -> dark low reeds. AudioHaxImg1.jpg (bri 29.3). MUST precede brass.
WARM . bright + energetic + low-colorfulness -> bright brass. AudioHaxImg2.jpg (bri 81, edge 0.51, cfl 0.08).
WARM . colorful -> warm plucked (OR-arm 1 of 2: colorfulness). AudioHaxImg3.jpg (cfl 0.42).
WARM . very-red hue -> warm plucked (OR-arm 2 of 2: hue<20). SelectRule is AND-only, so the spec OR is two rows.
WARM . smooth + saturated -> lush strings. Lena.png (tex 0.19, sat 51.9).
